subject.title: refactor(qqbot): adopt core typing keepalive loop with budget accounting intact

question: Should createTypingKeepaliveLoop become a supported public export on openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-outbound for plugins with channel-owned typing policy?
rationale: The implementation is generic and behaviorally sound, but publishing it creates a durable third-party API commitment; the mechanical contract-count repair should follow an explicit boundary decision.

options.title: Accept and Complete Contract
options.body: Keep the export, update the pinned SDK surface budgets and affected tests, and own the helper as a supported plugin API.

options.title: Keep Helper Internal
options.body: Remove the public export and route QQ through a bundled-only or other non-public seam to preserve the existing SDK boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept and Complete Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the export, update the pinned SDK surface budgets and affected tests, and own the helper as a supported plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared helper and QQ path and proposed the linked channel-refactor direction, making him the strongest available owner for this API-boundary decision.
